summary: Goldman Sachs Real Estate Finance Trust Inc filed an 8-K reporting (Item 3.02) sales of unregistered Class I and Class S common stock under its ongoing Reg D private offering: 125,406.326 Class I shares for $3,132,650 and 87,580.127 Class S shares for $2,208,050 including $22,050 upfront selling commissions. Item 8.01 disclosed monthly distributions payable about October 10, 2026 to holders of record September 30, 2026, plus two mortgage originations ($41.2M Kent, Washington industrial; $70.4M Bloomingdale, Georgia industrial). No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms or special-situation event; routine capital-raising and portfolio activity.
